name: Brandenburg an der Havel (Germany)
description: White field with a blue diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a green triangle in the lower fly, charged at the centre with the city arms of Brandenburg an der Havel (a red city gate with towers on white, under a crown).
history: Municipal flag of Brandenburg an der Havel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Brandenburg an der Havel arms — red gate and towers on white
